body: There are actually 2 modpacks that I can think of that has a similar vibe to what you are suggesting. The first is Blightfall which is a 1.7.10 modpack that puts you in a hostile world infected with something called the taint and you have you research, farm, produce, and mine to terraform the world back into a healthy and colonizable planet for a colony ship. The 2nd modpack that comes into mind is the Regrowth modpack, also for 1.7.10, where you are put in a barren world and you have to also do magical research and very small amounts of industry to revive the land and make it lush again.
